source: Codex re-probe c5 second turn (thread/resume with excludeTurns, then recall of the token), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; modelled as the next server lifetime of a confirmed session, so c5's first turn and unsubscribe are omitted; model/list reply spliced from re-probe cat (3 of 8 rows, descriptions neutralized); thread/start sandbox echo and turn/start sandboxPolicy adapted from the recorded read-only bound to dangerFullAccess (full, the only bound VIA admits); the run ends at VIA's stdin close (await_eof) after its last close, as the probe closed stdin at the end of the run (exit 0 recorded)

params.prompt: What token did I ask you to remember? Reply with just the token.

expect.notes: A session with a confirmed vendor thread id reopens on a new connection with thread/resume {threadId exact, excludeTurns:true, current sandbox mode}; the returned thread.id equals it, so identity is confirmed for this generation and no thread/start is sent (C2 §2 Reopen; vendors/codex.md §3 Reopen idle session). Turn overrides persist as thread defaults, so turn/start still carries every frozen value.
